newsitem.title: FRANCE: Guadeloupe airport cargo and mail traffic down.
newsitem.headline: Guadeloupe airport cargo and mail traffic down.

text.p: Pointe Pitre's Le Raizet airport, on the French island of Guadeloupe, handled 10,257 tonnes of air cargo traffic in the first nine months of 1996, a decline of 4.7 percent on the same period last year, airport authority figures show.

The main airlines present at Pointre Pitre airport are Air France and other French carriers -- Corsair, Air Outre Mer (AOM) and Air Liberte, which each operate scheduled passenger services using a mixture of Boeing 747 and DC10-30 aircraft.
Air France operates a weekly 747-200F frequency between Paris and Pointe a Pitre.
Postal traffic totalled 1,840 tonnes, down 9.8 percent on January-September 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
